opt_heading.message: Save web pages as local files

opt_lead.message: Alayo Get saves articles, X posts, quotes, images and videos as files in a local folder you choose. Articles are saved as Markdown, so any editor or notes app can open them.

opt_folderSuggest.message: We suggest creating a new folder named “Alayo Get” on this computer’s hard drive.

opt_folderICloud.message: Avoid iCloud Drive: with “Optimize Mac Storage” turned on, files may be replaced with placeholders.
opt_folderICloud.description: Setup step 1, macOS only; follows opt_folderSuggest

opt_stepReauth.message: After restarting the browser, allow access once more

opt_stepReauthBody.message: Chrome keeps access to a newly chosen folder only until the browser closes. The first time you save after a restart, Alayo Get will ask for access again. Choose $choice$ and you won’t be asked again.
opt_stepReauthBody.description: Placeholders other than counts are DOM elements (key caps, bold) inserted by richT().
